content: Ineem weɗ tah, ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, ɗu ɓi ŋ waaɗ keeh-keeh te ŋ marra ɗu hot, ɗu ɓi sumiŋ ngo na raayaaniŋ ngo, ŋoɗaat ndengiɗ ŋ Heɗi !
Sumaat ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Heɗi
Mi yii ñaah Ewodi na Sintik ne ɓa kerhiɗoh ŋ niki ɓa nik ŋ Heɗi.
Te fu yi ɓaah ho keeh-keeh ngaŋ pangki
, mi yii kiim ɗa ne fu ɓaatɗoh ɓitiɓ ceem, ɓa ɓaahee na so hiñohi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci, ɓeɗ na Kelema na huntoh ciŋ ngo ɓinooɓi. Tiik ciŋ ɓa fiisuuɗ ŋ teerndiŋ kipes ki.
Genaat sum ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Heɗi ; ŋ woyisa, sumaat !
Ɓooɓi jen inhaat baah kiŋ ɗu. Heɗi reɓiɗ.
Kinaat jaahiɗ ŋ ali in ; waaye ŋ in nu wa min nik ɗah, kiimaat Kooh, woyaat ɗe etoh ciŋ ɗu, te wa hun na corkiɗ ɗe.
Te jamiŋ Kooh, wi cootuk liiɓ nu nik, wa hey niiɗe keeñ ciŋ ɗu na liiɓohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.

Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ini tas weɗ ne : In nu nik keeh, na in nu nik eɗaah cir, in nu yurah, in nu hool, in nu nik waaɗaah, in nu nik baahiɗ ŋ hot-hotkiŋ ɓooɓi, in nu nik nawaah, na in nu nik ƴeekaah ɗah, ceɗ nikaat ŋ liiɓ ciŋ ɗu.
In ci ɗu jang nga so, ɗu rahassa ca, ɗu kerahha ca te ɗu hotta ca nga so, tumaat ca, te Kooh yi na onohe jam hey nike na ɗu.
Pool corkiɗiɗ ɓi Filippi ŋ onohiŋ ɓa
Ŋ niki ŋ nik ŋ Heɗi ŋ sumiɗ lool ŋ ini ɗu min teeɓohis yegi ɗu yeg go kotii. Te yegi ɗu yeg go weem wa moos moos nik. Ɗu raakeeɗi raakeeɗi waasi ɗu min ndo wa teeɓoh.
Nikɗi haa ne ŋ raak etoh weɗ tah ho woo ineem ; laam ŋ jangiɗ pes ngaŋ neɓu ŋ in nu nik.
Ŋ inhiɗ ini nik ŋ ñak, ŋ inhiɗ ini nik ŋ raak. Ŋ in nu nik na ɗisik nu nik, ŋ jangiɗ pes na kap, ŋ jangiɗ pes na aɗuk, ŋ jangiɗ pes ngaŋ raak-raak na ɓangtu.
Ŋ miniɗ in nu in ŋ niki ŋ nik ŋ Yi on ndo hatil.
Waaye ɓaahi ɗu ɓaah na so miskiɗiŋ ngo, wa in baahiɗ.
Ɗu ɓi Filippi, ɗu inhiɗ ŋ haf ɗu ne ŋ cambiŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ndeem, wa ŋ puloh Maseduwaan, ali Jangu ambtiɗoheeɗi na so ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kopor, ɗal ɗu.
Wa ŋ nik ŋ Tessalonik sah, ɗu woosohiɗ to ini ŋ etohe, te wa waas yino haa.
Wa nikɗi haa ne onohiŋ ɗu mi na rahse, weɗ nikiɗ to, waaye mi na waaɗe ne onohiŋ ɗu tum po ini kipes kiŋ ɗu rimɗan ɗu, ɓaatuk.
Ŋ rahsiɗ in ci ɗu woosoh jen, ɗiski ŋ nik, ŋ raakiɗ po ca uupiɗ ini ŋ etoh, Epaforodit eɗiɗ to in ci ɗu woosoh. Ini ɗu eɗ to, Kooh teyɗukiɗa findi seeƴuk eeñiɗ neɓiɗ te a sumiɗ nga.
Koohiŋ ngo hey ɗu paƴɗe etoh ciŋ ɗu jen ŋ raak-raak kiŋ ɗe na yaki a yak taamboh ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Koohiŋ ɓoo yi nam nik Baabiŋ ɓoo, a yakɗaah po faw ! Amiin !
Askohi
Kañɗaat ɓo'-Kooh ci nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu jen. Ɓaah ci nik na so ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗu.
Ɓo'-Kooh ci jen ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗu, ɓi nik ŋ kahan buuri yakkiŋ Rom ɓeɗ uup ɗu kañiɗ.
Baahohiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi nikaat na ɗu !

footnotes.text: "yi ɓaah ho ngaŋ pangki", wa "sisigos" ngaŋ gerek. Ŋ peɗeem gerek, wa mand na tiik, waaye ali ɓo' inahseeɗi na tiikeem ŋ jamanoonaam. Poyi, wa miniɗ nik tiik. Nik ne wa tiik ɗah, ɓo' miniɗa toksoh an : "Ee, fu yi kooɗ tiikiŋ Sisigos keeh-keeh, mi yii kiim ɗa ne fu ɓaatɗoh ɓitiɓ ceem"
